caption: The drawing features a central arrangement of botanical elements and birds. At the center, two birds, one with outstretched wings and the other perched, are surrounded by various plants and flowers that include leaves, stems, buds, and wheat-like stalks. The birds and floral arrangement are rendered in muted natural colors, with shades of brown, tan, olive green, and dull red. The background is a pale, slightly bluish or grayish surface with vertical brown-and-tan bands containing yellow lines along their inner edges running parallel on both sides of the central motif. The lower portion of the drawing displays a white, sketch-like, textured area suggesting either unfinished work or a depiction of surface distress. The composition is symmetrical in its vertical layout, and the depiction of botanical and animal forms is detailed but softly colored.
title: Window Shade
